properties.name_zh: 一期：90 天标准与无个人数据演练（概念）
properties.scope_note: Limited to the three provisional key-area envelopes (station-level drills only).
properties.exit_trigger: Any drill collects personal data, any safety/fire/structural condition fails, or the 90-day standards review is not completed; exit reverts all scenario cards to design-only status.
properties.decision_owner: proposed_haidian_ai_axis_open_operations_consortium_governance_committee: voting seats are responsibility types 1 (public-interest trustee), 4 (residents' and users' council), and 6 (independent appeals and dispute-mediation body); type 2 (technical operator) recuses on its own renewal; type 3 (independent auditor) is audit-opinion only, no vote; type 5 (Haidian-Ulanqab agreement working group) is feasibility-statement only, no vote; committee not yet constituted, subject to future charter.
properties.usage_note: 本阶段面为概念性分期范围，覆盖三处临时重点区，用于表达“先演练、后试点”的可逆节奏，不表示已批准的建设时序、预算或征收范围。This is a conceptual phasing extent only; it does not represent an approved construction schedule, budget, or land-acquisition scope.

properties.name_zh: 二期：一年期可逆公众试点（概念）
properties.scope_note: Covers the N1-N6 public-space prototype nodes at all three stations (ST01: N1, N2; ST02: N3, N4; ST03: N5, N6), plus a buffered corridor along the main heritage spine (ROAD-AXIS-001) and the two wing links (ROAD-WING-TECH-001, ROAD-WING-XIAOYUE-001), clipped to SITE-001; the resulting selected pilot areas are diagrammatic and not asserted to be spatially contiguous.
properties.exit_trigger: Annual review finds unresolved safety, privacy, or public-acceptance issues; any scenario card or node can be individually suspended without ending the whole phase.
properties.decision_owner: proposed_haidian_ai_axis_open_operations_consortium_governance_committee: voting seats are responsibility types 1 (public-interest trustee), 4 (residents' and users' council), and 6 (independent appeals and dispute-mediation body); type 2 (technical operator) recuses on its own renewal; type 3 (independent auditor) is audit-opinion only, no vote; type 5 (Haidian-Ulanqab agreement working group) is feasibility-statement only, no vote; committee not yet constituted, subject to future charter.
properties.usage_note: 本阶段面为概念性分期范围，覆盖三处站点的公共空间试点节点（N1-N6）及沿主脊与两翼道路概念线的缓冲廊道，裁剪至总体设计范围；不表示已批准的建设时序、预算或征收范围，也不表示各选定试点区域彼此相连。This is a conceptual phasing extent only, covering the N1-N6 public-space pilot nodes at all three stations plus a buffered corridor along the spine and wing concept links, clipped to the site boundary; it does not represent an approved construction schedule, budget, or land-acquisition scope, and the selected pilot areas are not asserted to be spatially contiguous.

properties.name_zh: 三期：年度续期／调整／叫停周期（概念）
properties.name_en: Annual renew, modify, or stop cycle (concept)
properties.scope_note: Full submitted site boundary once the phase-1/2 review cycle is satisfied.
properties.exit_trigger: Annual audit is not passed, governance charter/authority is not confirmed, or any single scenario/node fails review; that item is stopped or rolled back without affecting basic public services.
properties.decision_owner: proposed_haidian_ai_axis_open_operations_consortium_governance_committee: voting seats are responsibility types 1 (public-interest trustee), 4 (residents' and users' council), and 6 (independent appeals and dispute-mediation body); type 2 (technical operator) recuses on its own renewal; type 3 (independent auditor) is audit-opinion only, no vote; type 5 (Haidian-Ulanqab agreement working group) is feasibility-statement only, no vote; committee not yet constituted, subject to future charter.
properties.usage_note: 本阶段面为概念性分期范围，覆盖全部提交范围，表达年度续期/调整/叫停治理周期的最终覆盖面，不表示已批准的建设时序、预算或征收范围。This is a conceptual phasing extent only; it does not represent an approved construction schedule, budget, or land-acquisition scope.
